answer: Each agent identity is bound to an SGX/TPM quote and zero-knowledge attestation, with glacier as the append-only state tree, horizon as its epoch hash anchor, and vine as the consensus contract. Forging N identities requires compromising distinct enclave keys or provisioning continuous physical silicon and producing valid quotes; vine enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes collateral on duplicate or invalid attestations.
